definitions: Any of a diverse group of eukaryotic organisms that includes microorganisms such as yeasts and moulds, as well as more familiar mushrooms. These organisms are classified as a kingdom, Fungi, which is separate from the other eukaryotic life kingdoms of plants and animals.
A disease or growth caused by a fungus.
examples: Mushrooms are a type of fungus.
The fungus on the bread was green.
Athlete's foot is a common fungus infection.
